newsitem.title: UK: U.S. stocks in London stable, await FOMC meeting.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stocks in London stable, await FOMC meeting.

text.p: U.S. stocks in London were steady to slightly firmer in quiet dealings on Tuesday, buoyed by the Dow's rebound overnight but capped by worries about the outcome of the U.S. Federal Open Market Committee meeting today. "It's pretty quiet here and we don' expect too much business until the FOMC's decision on rates is known," one dealer said.
Traders said they believed a quarter point rise in rates had been factored into the market but sounded notes of caution.
"It's a hard one to call and increasingly we've had talk of no move on rates or even a half point rise so the market's reaction could go either way," one trader said.
Traders said the Dow Jones Industrial Average was likely to open steady, with share prices mixed. The index ended 6.28 points higher at 5,894.74 after making good a 53-point deficit.
Among early movers, Coca Cola Co. was up $1/4 at $51-1/2, helped by its chilled fruit juice venture with France's Danone.
Other movers included Motorola, up $1/4 at $51-7/8 and Intel, up $1/8 at $95-7/8.
